native.fontFamily: QApplication default system font; no family override or bundled font.

focus.treatment: 2px primary-color border on styled buttons, line edits, selectors, integer fields and slider; native semantics remain.

native.previewPolicy: Native Qt components have no fabricated HTML/CSS previews. Inspect source and actual screenshots.
native.tonalRampPolicy: No tonal ramps invented; only implemented palette primitives are normative.

window.behavior: Persistent numbered sidebar; independently scrolling pages, pinned actions and working/reference columns that stack below 780px available page width.

layout.columnStretch: 1 per panel horizontally; 0 vertically when stacked

actions: edit dial bounds and gain/avoid-zero roles
controlEditor.planPolicy: Training and held-out settings per switch combination; more than eight knobs use bounded axis boundary sweeps.
controlEditor.lockPolicy: Accepted-take lock applies to controls and plan even after captures are cleared.

native.evidenceDescription: Five stages at desktop and compact sizes, six additional job/Plan states, and four amp editor/target states. Capture fixtures have pending plans; Review uses an actual synthetic CPU export.

validation.finishReview: Fresh verdict: ship. All seven material findings resolved; compact Review uses the intended 28px visible gap. Final full suite: 43 passed in 45.53s with 3 upstream deprecation warnings. Mac/hardware verification remains outside this evidence.

components.name: Route and target group

narrative.overview:
The approved direction is a familiar light desktop utility: quiet working surfaces, blue actions, compact task labels and explicit state messages. The user chose the conventional utility in the [original mockups](docs/mockups/DESIGN.md) and requested closer native fidelity after seeing drift on Mac. Retain that commitment as the controls grow from pedals to amp layouts. Its signature remains a read-only physical dial target paired with a numerical position and confirmation before recording.

This refresh records the built [Qt shell](parametric_mac/gui.py) and [controls editor](parametric_mac/control_editor.py). The historical [workflow mockups](docs/mockups/overview.html) and [Plan proposal](docs/mockups/plan-quality.md) remain approved references. Qt code supplies production tokens; browser fonts, framing and example metrics do not. Evidence and unresolved finish findings belong in the [native handoff](docs/ui-audit/native-design-handoff.md), not in the visual system as new rules.
keyCharacteristics: Five persistent numbered stages with short secondary labels.
Working and reference columns, a centered coverage choice and pinned next actions.
Editable knobs and named switches, with readable rows and grouped physical targets.
Readiness, saved progress, actual run data and recovery explain the next task.

rules.name: The State Meaning Rule
rules.body: Explain readiness and recovery in text; color alone must not imply successful recording, finished sound quality or completed listening.

rules.name: The Pinned Handoff Rule
rules.body: Keep the stage's next action outside its scrolling content and show why it is unavailable.

rules.name: The Readable Control Rule
rules.body: Preserve control-row height and scroll longer layouts rather than squeezing editable fields and actions.

dos: **Do** preserve native Qt control semantics and visible keyboard focus.
**Do** keep working/reference columns, physical targets and pinned next actions readable as layouts grow.
**Do** retain readable control rows with direct Add, Remove and settings actions.
**Do** show named switch positions and real physical dial ranges.
**Do** explain locked or unavailable actions with a concrete next step.
**Do** derive counts, progress and review metrics from saved application data.
**Do** retain separate projects and source files when capture settings change.
donts: **Don't** interpret capture coverage as a guaranteed sound-quality rating.
**Don't** make the physical dial diagram appear interactive or automatic.
**Don't** copy browser font loading, phone breakpoints or example metrics into native truth.
**Don't** imply a completed export has been listened to or validated on real hardware.
**Don't** infer Mac/CoreAudio/MPS/VoiceOver verification from Linux offscreen screenshots.
